question: Do they compare human-level performance to model performance for their dataset?
title: Adversarial NLI: A New Benchmark for Natural Language Understanding
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents discuss comparing model performance to human-level performance indirectly, such as noting that models learn spurious patterns instead of human-like reasoning (Text 4) or that human annotators can construct examples to expose model weaknesses (Text 4, Text 6). However, none of the documents explicitly state or provide evidence that they directly compare human-level performance to model performance for their specific dataset.
